Research memo

Document ID: SYNTHETIC-RESEARCH-MEMO

Revision: 1

Operational memory is a reusable record of a decision, its rationale, and its evidence.

Evidence traceability lets a reader inspect the underlying material before reusing a claim.

The research team studies why a decision was made; this memo is separate from the operations memo with the same file name.
